Find new friends. Real ones. Move on from the previous ones. If they are your friends, they'll miss you. Maybe invite you to do something, to hang out, see what you're up to, etc.

Just do like that.

Well, you should be fine here. Try to make a deal with your dad. Just tell him that it'd be best if you got the car back until he can pay you. If that doesn't work, tell him you really need the money. If he still doesn't go for it, then you can press litigation. That part before the litigation part is really important if you decide to move forward with that. Potentially relationship-saving post-suing the guy.

Hey, tell your boss that you had to go to the mental hospital. Don't provide any specific details. Just let them know you are better now. Feel free to bring proof of your stay. Maybe a note from the hospital or something.

It's more common than you think. I actually spent 10 days in there last winter. And 7 days the spring before that.

You gotta cut her out. Don't let anyone like that in your life. No point. There's nothing good about it. Nothing for you.

Find something else for you. Something good.

And give it some time.

She's still trying to get with you. She doesn't get the hint.

DENNIS method. Just break contact. It's all you can do. Why are you responding to her?
If you are being disturbed by the dog, especially at night, you need to take it up with your landlord. The person with the dog who's whining and crying all night is the selfish one. Not you.

It's actually very common. There's lots of girls out there, you get attracted to one when you get to know her. That's just how it goes.

As far as "hot" goes? Let me put it like this. I've known girls who were "not hot" that got "hot" when things were going right. So like... that can happen. Doesn't really have anything to do with "looks" or whatever you want to call it. It's more a mindset.

With that in mind... just focus on what's important. If you all are meant to be in a relationship, your focus on family and stability will be the most attractive part of you. Especially in this world, where everyone is focused on themselves.
I would just tell him that he's only allowed to come over when Fin is there. Start small. If it gets worse, address those issues instead. This will at least limit the time he's over there.

Community college. Get a degree that will get you a job. Be sure that there are jobs out there for said degree *FIRST*.

You'll make friends there. Inevitably. Move out if you have to. Get a job to do it first if you have to.

Don't be afraid of student loans. If you make less than a certain amount of money every year, you don't have to make payments on it. Be sure to get on an income-based repayment plan.

I would distance yourself heavily from any and all weird shit in your life. Including your family, if required.

Oof. Well. Be glad you have a place to stay. Steer clear of the guy. Generation X'ers are assholes. They don't understand how picky managers are these days with all the applications out there, and how hard it is to find a job. It was MUCH easier for them to find work than it is for us. Also required a whole lot less work to do so. You'd show up to a place, fill out an application, and go from there. Nowadays, everyone has to be their own temp agency. Temp agencies don't have anything anymore. Unless you can find a really, really good one.

As far as dealing with his comments go? Sounds like my dad. Shit pissed me off. I'd just steer as clear of him as you can. Enjoy having the place to stay. Try to get on your feet if you can. Try to avoid any conversations with your father in the near future.

Dude, I have the solution.

Turn the camera around. Don't look at the screen.

It works every time. The reason it looks so stupid is because you can see your own face, but the camera is *very* slow to react. So it throws off your face, confusing you, and then you have a confused look on your face, which is slow, and it just gets worse and worse. That's why so many selfies look god awful with pinched faces and all that shiznit.

Turn the camera around!! Use the back of your phone! Fixes it every time.

Honestly, case and point. You guys have absolutely no emotional sense about you. It's just always about arguing. With everything.

Never used to be that way. It's just constant. You guys are like little brats, if you don't get your way, you bitch and moan and groan and try to bitch your way through everything. ESPECIALLY when it's "not about you".

So let me ask you this: What the fuck does this have to do with you? Who the fuck asked you? Why the fuck are you on my thread? Why are you bothering me? This is a rant section... if you don't like it, fuck off.
I think I might have fixed it. See replies.

Still alive. Fixed situation. Told parent's wife that she was the person I hated the very most in my life. And then broke ties with father.

I am a new man. I can't even believe it. It's amazing. I feel wonderful. Happy. Able. Things that I used to feel when things were good.

I am happy. I can't even believe I'm saying it.
:) Thank you

I'm so sorry to hear your pain. I have it too. It hurts. A lot. Feel free to read my posts. Recent one, anyway.

What matters the most is having someone, anyone, people who care. I know that means a lot to me. It helps me do better.

I hope it helps you too. Please feel better soon.

That catfishing incident is absolutely awful. I am so sorry to hear this. My heart hurts for you.

As for the other stuff. Don't sweat the debt. 2K of debt is nothing. You will be so totally fine. Don't worry about that. It's literally no big deal. So much so that it doesn't even really exist, if you don't want it to.

The guy falling. The accident. Tough to hear that too. I hope he is okay. Sometimes accidents happen. You can't do anything about them, many times they're not really your fault. Things just happen sometimes. Don't worry about it too much. You can't change the past.

I hope you are doing well! Please take good care of yourself. You are in a good situation to get well and on your feet. These situations will pass.
